components.name: Primary Button
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { background: #1D1C1A; color: #F3F0E6; padding: 14px 28px; border-radius: 6px; font-weight: 500; font-size: 15px; border: none; cursor: pointer; transition: background 0.2s ease, transform 0.15s ease; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: #33312E; transform: translateY(-1px); } .ds-btn-primary:active { transform: scale(0.98); }

components.name: Secondary Button
components.description: Transparent border button for download and secondary actions.
components.css: .ds-btn-secondary { background: transparent; color: #1D1C1A; border: 1px solid #E2DCD0; padding: 14px 28px; border-radius: 6px; font-weight: 500; font-size: 15px; cursor: pointer; transition: border-color 0.2s ease, background 0.2s ease; } .ds-btn-secondary:hover { border-color: #5C5A55; background: rgba(234, 228, 215, 0.5); }

narrative.overview: An authoritative, typography-first editorial sanctuary inspired by literary journals and high-craft technical publications. The visual world blends the warmth and timeless dignity of textured cream paper with the exacting precision of production engineering.
keyCharacteristics: Warm, tactile paper ground with verified WCAG AAA/AA text contrast.
Commanding serif display typography (Lora) paired with crystalline modern sans-serif body text (Inter).
Burnt sienna terracotta accent used with deliberate restraint to punctuate key interactive states and titles.
Generous whitespace, quiet structural rules, and tactile micro-physics rather than theatrical animations.

rules.name: The Rarity Rule
rules.body: The terracotta accent is applied to less than 10% of any viewport. Its scarcity preserves its authority.

rules.name: The No-Kicker Rule
rules.body: Section titles and major headings speak for themselves; eyebrow tags and decorative kickers above headings are strictly avoided.

rules.name: The Flat-By-Default Rule
rules.body: Content surfaces rest flat at zero elevation. Shadows appear only in response to user state.

dos: Do maintain a strict 65–75ch line measure for body paragraphs.
Do preserve the warm paper background (#F3F0E6) and deep charcoal foreground (#1D1C1A).
Do ensure all interactive controls have accessible :focus-visible rings in terracotta accent (#B8471D).
Do let headings carry their own weight without decorative prefix badges.
donts: Don't use text gradients under any circumstances.
Don't use generic boxed metric counters ('X+ Years', 'Y+ Projects').
Don't place eyebrow labels or kickers above headings.
Don't use cold grays; all secondary text must carry the warm slate-taupe hue (#5C5A55).
